مِحْرَاثٌ The thing (i. e. the piece of wood, or the wooden thing, TA) with which the fire is stirred (S, A, K) in the [kind of oven called] تَنُّور; (S;) as also ↓ مِحْرَثٌ : (K:) and مِحْرَاثُ النَّارِ the shovel (مِسْحَاة) with which the fire is stirred. (TA.) [Hence,] مِحْرَاثُ الحَرْبِ (assumed tropical:) That which [or he who] stirs up, or excites, war. (TA.) ―
-b2- [In the present day, it signifies A plough: and (like حَرْثٌ) a ploughshare.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
